_comment: Per-entity-type attribute seeds and caps. Entity attributes are whole-entity stats, OWNED BY THE ENTITY (distinct from per-component stats, which live on component instances). Each attribute is keyed in the flat "Group.stat" wire form (identical to the organ-grant key form) and declares three things: the initial `value`, the hard `max` (capacity the value is clamped into, and the full-battery ceiling for fuel burners), and the per-turn `drainPerTurn` the global per-turn energy step subtracts from the value. Energy is a life pool: it is charged by a coal burner (the M1 central body's coalGenerator, consumeFuelGenerateStat) and drained every turn; when an entity's energy attribute reaches 0 it is eliminated — its contents spill to the floor and the entity is despawned. The M1 droid's 100-unit energy battery is the only seeded attribute today. Balance levers (initial charge, cap, per-turn draw) are deliberately data-driven, not magic numbers in a controller.
